reasons: F01, F02, F03, F05, F06, F07, F14, F15, F16, F17: clean control and governance profile - no material weakness, unqualified ICFR opinion, no auditor change or disagreement, no prior-period correction, stable CEO/CFO, no SEC inquiry or class action; this substantially lowers concern.
R08, R19: total accruals are high positive and operating cash flow is well below net income (<0.8x), indicating earnings quality is weak and reported income is not backed by cash.
R17: Dechow F-score is above the 1.0 threshold, signalling elevated misstatement likelihood relative to base rates, although R09 (Beneish M-score below threshold) does not corroborate.

R01, R18, F10: days sales in receivables elevated and receivables growing slightly faster than sales, combined with channel return rights or bill-and-hold arrangements, raise some revenue cut-off / channel-stuffing risk; however the deterioration is modest.

F22, F24, R03, R13: a major acquisition in the year with business combination as a critical audit matter, an elevated asset quality index and a very high soft-asset share (>75%) imply heavy judgment in purchase price allocation, goodwill and intangibles; the acquisition may also explain the accrual and asset-quality signals mechanically.

R02, R05, R15: gross margin is declining while ROA rises and depreciation is slowing, a pattern consistent with possible earnings support through estimate changes (useful lives) rather than operations.
F18, F24: an other government investigation is disclosed and tax is a critical audit matter, adding contingency and estimate risk, though not directly an accounting investigation.

F21, R16, F26, F28: securities issued / capital raise create incentive to present favourable results; non-GAAP emphasis and a segment reporting change can reduce comparability, but these are common around acquisitions.

R04, R06, R07, F19, F20, F04: moderate sales growth, normal SG&A, stable or falling leverage, no covenant issues, no revenue/EPS-linked pay and no going-concern doubt limit pressure-based fraud motives.
